description: Defines the DrmManagerClient class and related interfaces for managing DRM content, including session handling, rights management, and content metadata.

classes.name: DrmManagerClient
classes.description: Main class for managing DRM sessions, rights, and content metadata.

methods.name: openDecryptSession
methods.description: Opens a DRM decryption session using file descriptor, URI, or buffer.

methods.name: closeDecryptSession
methods.description: Closes an active DRM decryption session.

methods.name: consumeRights
methods.description: Consumes rights for a DRM-protected content.

methods.name: setPlaybackStatus
methods.description: Informs DRM engine about playback actions.

methods.name: initializeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Initializes decryption for a specific content unit.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted content buffers.

methods.name: finalizeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Finalizes decryption for a content unit.

methods.name: pread
methods.description: Reads bytes from an open DRM file.

methods.name: validateAction
methods.description: Validates if an action on DRM content is permitted.

methods.name: setOnInfoListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for DRM info events.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves constraints for DRM content.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for DRM content.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if content can be handled by DRM framework.

methods.name: processDrmInfo
methods.description: Processes DRM information.

methods.name: acquireDrmInfo
methods.description: Retrieves DRM info for registration or rights acquisition.

methods.name: saveRights
methods.description: Saves DRM rights to a specified path.

methods.name: getOriginalMimeType
methods.description: Gets the original MIME type of protected content.

methods.name: getDrmObjectType
methods.description: Determines the DRM object type based on path or MIME.

methods.name: checkRightsStatus
methods.description: Checks if rights are valid for content.

methods.name: removeRights
methods.description: Removes rights for specific content.

methods.name: removeAllRights
methods.description: Removes all DRM rights (e.g., master reset).

methods.name: openConvertSession
methods.description: Starts a DRM conversion session.

methods.name: convertData
methods.description: Converts DRM data blocks.

methods.name: closeConvertSession
methods.description: Ends a DRM conversion session.

methods.name: getAllSupportInfo
methods.description: Retrieves supported DRM info instances.
